# RZCode Documentation - LLMs Context Guide
# Website: https://rzcode.vip/rzcodedocs/
# Purpose: Documentation and guides for software copyright (软著) application tool
# Language: Chinese (Simplified) with English support
# Last Updated: 2026-10-13

## Project Overview

**Project Name:** RZCode / 软宝宝 (Ruanzhu Baobao)
**Purpose:** AI-powered software copyright (软著 / software copyright registration) application tool
**Target Users:** Software developers, enterprises, copyright agencies, startups
**Core Value:** Automates generation of software copyright application materials with code privacy protection

## Key Features & Capabilities

### 1. Automated Material Generation
- Source code documentation auto-generation from project files
- Software operation manual creation from screenshots
- Design documentation compilation
- Application form field auto-fill

### 2. Code Privacy Protection
- Local cooperation mode: code stays on user's machine
- MCP Server integration: AI accesses code locally without upload
- No server-side code storage

### 3. Application Management
- Project creation and organization
- File upload and processing
- Material export and packaging
- Application submission tracking

### 4. Progress Tracking (Footprints)
- Real-time status monitoring from copyright office
- Timeline visualization
- Historical record access
- Important deadline reminders

### 5. Accelerated Processing
- 30-day expedited examination option
- Fast-track approval channel
- Direct integration with copyright office

## Content Organization Patterns

### Front Matter Fields (All Pages)
- **title:** Page title with SEO optimization
- **description:** Meta description for search engines
- **keywords:** Array of relevant keywords (e.g., 软著, 软件著作权, 申请工具)
- **lead:** Introductory paragraph
- **date:** Publication date
- **lastmod:** Last modification date
- **type:** Content type (docs or blog)
- **layout:** Page layout (single)
- **toc:** Table of contents enabled (true)
- **params.seo.canonical:** Full domain URL for duplicate prevention
- **params.seo.robots:** Crawl directives (index, follow)

### SEO Strategy
- **Primary Keywords:** 软著, 软件著作权, 软著申请, 软著工具, 申请工具
- **Target Audience Keywords:** 开发者, 企业, 代理机构, 初创公司
- **Feature Keywords:** 源代码文档, 操作说明书, 设计文档, 隐私保护, 加急申请
- **Brand Terms:** 软宝宝, RZCode, rzcode.vip

### URL Structure
- Docs: `/rzcodedocs/docs/[section]/[page]/`
- Blog: `/rzcodedocs/blog/[section]/[date-or-slug]/`
- Canonical: Full URLs with https://rzcode.vip/rzcodedocs/ prefix

## Navigation Hierarchy

```
/rzcodedocs/

│   ├── /quick_guides/ (5 guides + index)

├── /blog/

│   ├── /techniques/ (technical articles)
│   └── _index.md
├── robots.txt
├── llms.txt
└── sitemap-docs.xml
```
